frontmatter.p: AN ACT TO APPLY CERTAIN SUMS OUT OF THE CENTRAL FUND TO THE SERVICE OF THE YEARS ENDING ON THE THIRTY-FIRST DAY OF MARCH ONE THOUSAND NINE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-ONE AND ONE THOUSAND NINE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-TWO. [27th March, 1931.]

p.font: Issue of 385,565 out of the Central Fund for the service of the year ending the 31st March, 1931.

sect.p: 1.The Minister for Finance may issue out of the Central Fund and apply towards making good the supply granted for the service of the year ending on the thirty-first day of March one thousand nine hundred and thirty-one the sum of Three Hundred and Eighty-five Thousand Five Hundred and Sixty-five Pounds.
